title: Brood Pattern (collapsing)
rules_text: Brood Pattern with the claw taking the floor rather than scorching it. Ground nothing can cross, and nothing can be called onto.

instant_beats.title: Raking Claw
instant_beats.rules_text: Target: Tank, within 1 hex. Deal 4 damage.

instant_beats.title: Give Way
instant_beats.rules_text: The ground the claw struck falls through. It never comes back, nothing crosses it, and no Whelp arrives on it.

incoming_beats.title: Within Reach
incoming_beats.rules_text: If no hero stands adjacent to Embermaw at the end of this Round, Escalation rises by 1.

incoming_beats.title: Brood Call
incoming_beats.rules_text: Whelps emerge at the marked edge hexes. Each one detonates on the next Round's Incoming Row, burning every Hero within 1 hex and raising Escalation by 1.
